defect: WriteCopyStatement names the range-for variable info, shadowing the CopyInfo parameter info whose options it iterates (for (auto &info : info.options)), which GCC 4.9 fails to compile.
reason: The fix only renames that loop variable added by this change to copy_option, repairing a compile failure on a then-supported compiler.

defect: The fix adds the right-hand struct child types to the map value upgrade in IsStructColumnValid/UpgradeType and a redundant can_convert guard in InnerAnalyze.
reason: IsStructColumnValid and UpgradeType were written in later commits, and the added can_convert check is a no-op for this change's code, where can_convert is always true after the loop.

defect: The fix adds an early out for CREATE TABLE AS when the table already exists (issue 1891).
reason: The change only replaced size() > 0 with !empty(); the missing existence check predates it.

defect: The fix adds a static ResizeThreshold(capacity) overload for a memory usage computation elsewhere.
reason: Switching NumericCast to LossyNumericCast is correct; the fix is a refactor that adds an overload.

defect: The fix adds stored_allocators_size to the MaxThreads reservation, divides partitions_fit by max_partition_size, and uses ResizeThreshold for the sink capacity check.
reason: The stored_allocators_size and usable_memory code came from later commits, and this change only merged SetRemainingSize plus UpdateReservation into one call with the same arguments.

defect: The fix exempts PhysicalType::ARRAY child columns from the out-of-range check in ListColumnData::ScanCount.
reason: PhysicalType::ARRAY did not exist when this change turned the assert into an exception, so the check was correct for the types of the time.

defect: The change puts persistent segments into the same data tree as transient segments, but InitializeAppend still casts data.GetLastSegment() to TransientSegment, so after a reload it appends into a persistent segment.
reason: The fix checks for a PERSISTENT last segment and appends a new transient one, repairing exactly the cast this change created by unifying the trees.

defect: The fix implements index-creation scans over persistent segments (ScanCreateIndex), replacing the FIXME throw.
reason: The 'FIXME: scan persistent data' throw predates this change, which only removed the version filtering for transient rows; the fix adds a missing feature.

defect: PandasColumn stores the result of getter(names[index]) as a non-owning py::handle, so when the column object is created on access, its temporary py::object is freed and the handle dangles.
reason: The old code held the column in an owning py::object, and the fix (issue 8321) changes the member and the constructor parameter that this change introduced to py::object.

defect: The fix renames IsOpen to HasFileHandle and IsDone to !IsOpen, moves Reset into OpenJSONFile without the lock, and drops the cached_buffers clear, completing the fix for issue 8695.
reason: This change was itself partial work on the pre-existing issue 8695, and the fix mostly restructures its lines with the same semantics rather than repairing a new defect it introduced.

defect: The fix reorders members and declarations, adds HasFileHandle in place of IsDone, and changes GetBuffer to return optional_ptr.
reason: The header change (new record type enum, file_options, member reordering) has no defect that the fix repairs; the fix is an API cleanup for issue 8695.

defect: HandleStructExtractRecursive, declared here with one ColumnIndex out-parameter, builds the index by AddChildIndex at each level, so for more than two nested struct levels the deeper fields become siblings instead of nested children.
reason: The fix (for structs nested more than two layers deep) replaces this change's ColumnIndex out-parameter with a vector of indexes and builds the nesting correctly; the defect sits in the matching .cpp implementation.

defect: GetMetricAsString returns extra_info raw, and PrintAllMetricsToSS writes it between JSON quotes without escaping, which the old profiler code did with JSONSanitize.
reason: The fix wraps GetExtraInfo in JSONSanitize in the function this rework added, restoring valid JSON output.

defect: The fix takes key_type by reference and derives it from hash_table->equality_types instead of a key_type set only in Sink, which stayed INVALID when the build side was empty.
reason: Moving by-value LogicalType parameters is harmless; the invalid key type comes from physical_hash_join's sink.key_type, which predates this tidy change.

defect: The fix removes sink.key_type, set in Sink, and takes the perfect hash join key type from hash_table->equality_types in Finalize.
reason: The key_type field and its Sink assignment were added by a later commit (4547b4c), not by this change, and the other edits in the fix are style.

defect: The fix removes the key_type member from HashJoinGlobalState.
reason: This change only moved HashJoinGlobalState, with its existing key_type member, from the .cpp into the header; the invalid key type predates it.

defect: The fix adapts ART::Merge to the new ResolvePrefixesAndMerge signature, adding a null parent and a position argument.
reason: In art.cpp the fix only follows an interface change made in node code while debugging; the bool return this change added is not repaired.

defect: The new case-insensitive child-name check in CombineEqualTypes rejects combining an unnamed struct with a named struct of the same shape, which used to merge by position.
reason: The fix (issue 11467) skips this change's name check when either struct is unnamed and takes the names from the named side.

defect: ParquetScanInitGlobal compares col_idx against the exported data constant COLUMN_IDENTIFIER_ROW_ID, which a loadable extension on Windows cannot reference, breaking the Windows build.
reason: The fix replaces that comparison, added by this change, with the exported IsRowIdColumnId function, which exists precisely for this Windows extension restriction.

defect: The change adds a stray copy of src/function/scalar/list/list_concat.cpp under extension/core_functions, duplicating ListConcatFun definitions and breaking the Python package build, which compiles all sources.
reason: The fix deletes the file this change added and adjusts the build scripts, repairing a build failure on the Python build.

defect: The fix adds BindingType::ENTRY and passes it in master's new EntryBinding constructor after a merge.
reason: The compile failure came from merging master's EntryBinding into this branch, not from a defect in the BindingType enum or constructor this change added.

defect: The fix adapts ExpandGeneratedColumn and the debug check to master's GetStandardEntry API and passes BindingType::ENTRY after a merge.
reason: The fix is a merge adaptation to API changes from master, not a repair of a defect in the generated-column binding this change added.

defect: The change routes LOGICAL_EXCEPT into PullUpEmptyJoinChildren, whose D_ASSERT admits only COMPARISON_JOIN and ANY_JOIN, so debug builds hit an assertion on EXCEPT.
reason: The fix extends that assertion to LOGICAL_EXCEPT (and adds a missing break and include), repairing the assertion failure this change introduced.

defect: SniffValue resets value to current_char when a new value starts and then appends current_char again for STANDARD state, doubling the first character of every value, and it drops characters of quoted values.
reason: The fix resets value to an empty string and keeps quoted characters, repairing the wrong sniffed values in the function this change added.

defect: LCMOperator returns left * (right / gcd) without taking the absolute value, so lcm with a negative argument gives a negative result.
reason: The fix returns the absolute value of the result in the LCM operator this change added.

defect: The DEBUG-only member is declared as unqualified vector<uint8_t> inside namespace duckdb_chimp, where duckdb::vector is not visible, so debug builds fail to compile.
reason: The fix qualifies the declaration this change wrote as duckdb::vector.

defect: The fix returns early on child-count mismatch, builds the map value type from both structs' children, uses structs[reference_entry] in VerifyStructValidity, and drops later timestamp/time-tz detection.
reason: This refactor preserves the old behaviour, and the out-of-bounds access on size mismatch, the left-only map value type and the structs[0] bug all predate it; the datetime code came later.

defect: The fix reworks IN-filter extraction so that nested CONJUNCTION_AND filters take the union of their IN values.
reason: This tidying only replaced a unique_ptr to a vector with a vector; nested conjunction handling was added and broken later.

defect: PropagateStructExtractStats calls Copy() on struct_stats.child_stats[info.index] without checking it for null, so a struct whose child has no statistics dereferences null.
reason: The fix adds the null check on the child statistics in the function this change added.

defect: The new hugeint decimal rounding is off by one: it sets decimal_total_digits to -e - 1, subtracts exponent + 1, and divides by POWERS_OF_TEN[decimal_total_digits], so the leading decimal digit is computed wrongly.
reason: The fix corrects exactly these digit counts in HandleExponent and Finalize, both written by this change.

defect: DataChunk::Slice references the source dictionary vector and then MergeDictionaries rewrites the selection vector inside the shared DictionaryBuffer, corrupting the source chunk's dictionary.
reason: The fix makes Vector::Slice give the sliced vector a new DictionaryBuffer instead of mutating the shared selection; its data[c] vs data[col_offset + c] part repairs a later commit.

defect: The fix wraps JemallocExtension::DecayDelay() in NumericCast to silence a sign-conversion warning.
reason: The optional_idx return type that caused the warning was introduced later; the int64_t version in this change compiles cleanly.

defect: The binder stores the address of the stack vector local_bindings in the member lambda_bindings and never resets it, leaving a dangling pointer for the next lambda bound by the same binder.
reason: The fix sets lambda_bindings back to nullptr once the outermost lambda pops its binding, repairing the dangling pointer this change created.

defect: The fix adds missing release calls for statements, connections and databases in the ADBC tests.
reason: The fix is a test change that plugs leaks in test code.

defect: The fix wraps the int64 metadata offsets in NumericCast<idx_t> to silence sign-compare warnings introduced by switching the parameters to idx_t.
reason: The behaviour is unchanged (negative offsets still fail the range check); the fix is a signedness-warning cleanup within the same type migration.

defect: The fix drops the explicit single_threaded = false argument to CSVFileScan as part of reverting the single-threaded buffer change.
reason: Passing false equalled the parameter's default, so there was no defect; the fix is a revert of the API.

defect: The fix removes the single_threaded argument from the CSVFileScan constructor calls while removing that parameter from the API.
reason: The fix reverts the single_threaded constructor parameter (restoring the old buffer manager) rather than repairing a defect in this change's progress computation.

defect: SetOperationNode::Serialize writes the new children property when ShouldSerialize(6) holds, but version 6 is the already released v1.4.0, so files targeting v1.4.0 contain a property it cannot read.
reason: The fix moves the gate to a new serialization version 7 (and updates version_map.json), repairing the compatibility break in the line this change added.

defect: DataPointer::Serialize stops writing row_start when ShouldSerialize(6) holds, but version 6 is the already released v1.4.0, which still reads row_start, so files written for v1.4.0 lack it.
reason: The fix gates on the new version 7 instead, repairing the backward-compatibility break this change introduced.

defect: The fix moves the duckdb_append_default_to_chunk #define to its generated position in the header.
reason: The order of #define lines has no effect on compilation; the fix only makes the header match the generator output.
